description: Customisable settings for the workplace app

sentry_dsn.description: Connector string for setting up Sentry

show_changelog.description: Whether the version in user controls links to the changelog modal

environment_bar.description: CSS colour for thin environment identifier bars shown at the top and bottom of the app. Leave unset to hide the bars.

menu_embeds.description: Additional menu items that open third-party URLs embedded in the app.

general.description: General settings associated with the app

menu.description: Data associated with rendering menus in the app

copyright.description: Copyright organisation to render in the menu

position.description: Side of the screen to render the overlay menu

banner.description: Details for a dismissable banner shown at the top of the app

id.description: Unique identifier for the banner. Used to remember whether the user has dismissed it

type.description: Type of banner to display. Affects the banner colour

content.description: Message content to display in the banner

dark_mode.description: Whether dark mode is enabled by default

home.description: Data associated with rendering the home page in the app

background.description: URL of the background image to render on the home page

tiles.description: List of links to render as tiles on the home page

footer.description: List of links to render as tiles in the footer menu

help.description: Data associated with rendering the home page in the app

tiles.description: List of links to render as tiles on the home page

columns.description: Number of columns with which to display the help page tiles

show_fields.description: Form fields available for use in the booking flow

html_body.description: Whether booking form should allow for a HTML body in the event data

multiple_spaces.description: Whether users are allowed to book multiple spaces in the booking flow

setup.description: Default setup time for new bookings in minutes

breakdown.description: Default breakdown time for new bookings in minutes

allowed_daily_desk_count.description: Number of allowed desk bookings for a single day. `0` for unlimited. Defaults to `1`

force_current_user_for_booking_rules.description: Whether booking rule checks should always use the signed-in user as the host, even when booking on behalf of someone else.

assigned_resource_booking.description: Controls booking for users with an assigned desk, parking space, or locker. Allow permits all bookings, deny blocks booking, and other_only permits booking only on behalf of another user. Override per type under app.<type>s.* (e.g. app.desks.*).

no_approval.description: Whether new bookings should skip the approval process and be created in the approved state

all_day_default.description: Whether the all day option is on by default for new bookings

allowed_daily_visitor_count.description: Maximum number of visitor invites allowed for a single day

multiple_visitors.description: Whether a visitor invite can include multiple visitors

allow_all_day.description: Whether the all day option is available in resource booking flows. Override per type under app.<type>s.*

can_book_for_others.description: Whether users can make bookings on behalf of other users. Override per type under app.<type>s.*

can_book_for_anyone.description: Whether users can make bookings on behalf of anyone, including external users. Override per type under app.<type>s.*

custom_duration_options.description: Custom list of duration options, in minutes, to offer in booking duration selection. Override per type under app.<type>s.*

duration_step.description: Step, in minutes, between generated duration options. Defaults to 30. Override per type under app.<type>s.*

has_assets.description: Whether asset requests are available in resource booking flows. Override per type under app.<type>s.*

max_duration.description: Maximum booking duration in minutes. Override per type under app.<type>s.*

min_duration.description: Minimum booking duration in minutes. Override per type under app.<type>s.*

use_building_timezone.description: Whether booking times should be displayed and booked using the building's timezone. Override per type under app.<type>s.*

visitors.description: Visitor invite settings. These override the matching bookings settings

allow_all_day.description: Whether the all-day option is available for visitor invites. Overrides app.bookings.allow_all_day

can_book_for_others.description: Whether users can invite visitors on behalf of another internal host. Overrides app.bookings.can_book_for_others

can_book_for_anyone.description: Whether users can invite visitors on behalf of any host, including external users. Overrides app.bookings.can_book_for_anyone

events.description: Data associated with meeting booking flow

hide_nearby_desks.description: Whether to hide the book nearby desks action on the meeting success view

force_current_user_for_booking_rules.description: Whether meeting room booking rule checks should always use the signed-in user as the host, even when booking on behalf of someone else.

multiple_spaces.description: Whether users can book multiple spaces in a single meeting

desk_start.description: Default start time, in hours of the day, for desk bookings

can_book_for_others.description: Whether users can create meetings on behalf of another host

has_catering.description: Whether the catering step is available in the meeting booking flow

has_assets.description: Whether asset requests are available in the meeting booking flow

allow_all_day.description: Whether the all day option is available for meeting bookings

hide_notes.description: Whether to hide the notes field on the meeting form

hide_attendees.description: Whether to hide the attendees field on the meeting form

features_label.description: Custom label for the space features field in the meeting flow

features_on_form.description: Whether space features are shown on the meeting form

booking_unavailable.description: Whether room booking is unavailable. When true, submitting the meeting form opens a modal with a link to the alternate booking method instead of creating the event

allow_externals.description: Whether external (non-directory) attendees can be added to meetings

allow_recurrence.description: Whether recurring meetings can be created

allow_daily_allday_recurrence.description: Whether daily recurrence is allowed for all day meetings

allow_online_meetings.description: Whether the online meeting option is available on the meeting form

allow_multiday.description: Whether meetings are allowed to span multiple days

no_standalone.description: Whether meetings must include at least one room. When true, submitting a meeting without a space selected shows an error

strict_capacity_check.description: Whether the attendee count is strictly limited by the total capacity of the selected spaces

use_bookings.description: Whether room meetings are managed using the PlaceOS bookings API instead of calendar events

use_building_timezone.description: Whether meeting times should be displayed and booked using the building's timezone

desks.description: Data associated wth desk booking flow

use_assets.description: Whether desk resources are read through the assets API instead of Zone metadata

has_group_booking.description: Whether users are allowed make group desk bookings

hide_reason.description: Whether to disable ability for user to set a reason for desk booking

can_set_host.description: Whether user is allowed to make desk bookings for others

can_book_lockers.description: Whether users can book a locker as part of the desk booking flow

can_book_for_others.description: Whether users can book desks on behalf of other users. Overrides app.bookings.can_book_for_others

allow_groups.description: Whether group desk bookings are allowed

allow_time_changes.description: Whether users can change the time of desk bookings

allow_all_day.description: Whether the all day option is available for desk bookings. Overrides app.bookings.allow_all_day

auto_allocation.description: Whether desks are automatically allocated instead of being selected by the user

show_calendar_links.description: Whether add to calendar links are shown on the desk booking success view

allow_recurrence.description: Whether recurring desk bookings are allowed

hide_map.description: Whether to hide the map when selecting desks

default_select_as_map.description: Whether the desk selection modal defaults to the map view instead of the list view

default_duration.description: Default duration for desk bookings in minutes

custom_duration_options.description: Custom list of duration options, in minutes, for desk bookings. Overrides app.bookings.custom_duration_options

duration_step.description: Step, in minutes, between duration options for desk bookings. Overrides app.bookings.duration_step. Defaults to 30

has_assets.description: Whether asset requests are available in the desk booking flow. Overrides app.bookings.has_assets

max_duration.description: Maximum desk booking duration in minutes. Overrides app.bookings.max_duration. Defaults to 480

min_duration.description: Minimum desk booking duration in minutes. Overrides app.bookings.min_duration. Defaults to 60

needs_reason.description: Whether desk bookings require a reason to be entered

use_building_timezone.description: Whether desk booking times should use the building's timezone. Overrides app.bookings.use_building_timezone

parking.description: Data associated with the parking booking and request flows

allow_recurrence.description: Whether multi-day recurrence options should be available in parking flows

request_submission_notes_html.description: Optional sanitized HTML content shown in the parking request summary and submission section.

request_shift_options.description: Shift presets shown in the parking request flow. Each preset can optionally be limited to specific user groups. The custom shift option is always shown separately.

auto_approved_groups.description: List of user group names that are auto-approved for parking requests. Users in these groups will not see the approver group selector.

request_types.description: Request type options shown in the parking request flow. Each item requires an `id` or `value` and a `name` or `label`. Optional `description`, `badge`, and `forced_time` fields. Defaults to standard, special, and after_hours types.

request_space_restrictions.description: Space restriction options shown in the parking request flow. If this list is empty, the field is hidden.

extra_space_restrictions.description: Additional space restriction options shown as on/off toggles in the parking request flow. Multiple toggles can be enabled at once. Each item requires an `id` and a `name` (translation key or label).

vehicle_types.description: Vehicle type options shown in the parking request flow. Defaults to car, bike, van, truck, and other.

hidden_buildings.description: List of building (zone) IDs to hide from the location options in the parking request flow. Buildings without any levels tagged 'parking' are always hidden.

hide_prefer_toggle.description: Whether to hide the 'Prefer booked location first' toggle in the location preference section of the parking request flow.

hide_custom_shift.description: Whether to hide the custom option from the shift selection dropdown in the parking request flow.

hide_selected_space.description: Whether to hide selected parking space names in booking cards and booking detail modals.

hide_availability_counter.description: Whether to hide the parking availability counter shown next to the selected location or level.

require_plate_number.description: Whether the plate number/registration field is mandatory in the parking request flow.

require_space_restriction.description: Whether users must select a parking space restriction in the parking request flow.

show_status_details.description: Whether the explore parking tooltip should show availability status details such as status text, assigned users, and plate numbers.

allow_all_day.description: Whether the all day option is available for parking bookings. Overrides app.bookings.allow_all_day

available_period.description: Number of days into the future that parking can be booked. Defaults to 7

can_book_for_others.description: Whether users can book parking on behalf of other users. Overrides app.bookings.can_book_for_others

can_book_for_anyone.description: Whether users can book parking on behalf of anyone, including external users. Overrides app.bookings.can_book_for_anyone

custom_duration_options.description: Custom list of duration options, in minutes, for parking bookings. Overrides app.bookings.custom_duration_options

max_duration.description: Maximum parking booking duration in minutes. Overrides app.bookings.max_duration. Defaults to 480

min_duration.description: Minimum parking booking duration in minutes. Overrides app.bookings.min_duration. Defaults to 30

show_calendar_links.description: Whether add to calendar links are shown on the parking booking success view

use_building_timezone.description: Whether parking booking times should use the building's timezone. Overrides app.bookings.use_building_timezone

show_images.description: Whether UI should render images associated with the space

show_avatars.description: Whether UI should render avatars associated with the user

min_search_length.description: Minimum number of characters needed to start performing a user

colors.description: Mapping of keys to their color values. Keys are usual in the format `<type>-<status>`

can_select_building.description: Whether user is allowed to select different buildings to view

show_legend.description: Whether to show the legend on the explore map

show_legend_group_names.description: Whether legend group names should be shown

hide_zones.description: Whether to hide the areas toggle on the explore map

hide_devices.description: Whether to hide the devices toggle on the explore map

hide_sensors.description: Whether to hide the sensors toggle on the explore map

use_zone_polygons.description: Whether zones should be rendered on the map using their polygon data

show_simple_sensor_info.description: Whether to show simplified sensor information on the explore map

show_presence_indicators.description: Whether presence indicator icons are shown on spaces with presence sensors

use_cisco_maps.description: Whether to use Cisco Spaces maps instead of the default interactive SVG maps

cisco_maps.description: Configuration for connecting to Cisco Spaces maps

script.description: URL of the Cisco Spaces digital map script to load

api_endpoint.description: API endpoint for Cisco Spaces requests

access_token.description: API key used for Cisco Spaces API requests

name.description: Name of the application. Used in the browser page title

logo_light.description: Logo shown in the top bar when using the light theme. Either an image URL or an icon object with a `src` property

logo_dark.description: Logo shown in the top bar when using the dark theme. Either an image URL or an icon object with a `src` property

locales.description: List of locales available in the language selector

name.description: Display name for the language. Supports translation keys

local.description: Name of the language in that language

flag.description: Emoji flag displayed next to the language name

features.description: List of feature flags controlling which sections of the app are available e.g. `spaces`, `desks`, `explore`, `parking`, `help`, `schedule`, `lockers`, `visitor-invite`, `group-events`

currency.description: Currency code used when displaying prices

default_route.description: Route to redirect users to when entering the application

use_geolocation.description: Whether to use the device's geolocation to select the closest building on load

use_24_hour_time.description: Whether times should be displayed using a 24 hour clock

new_features.description: Whether new feature hints should be shown in the UI

can_deliver.description: Whether delivery is available for catering orders

no_user_calendar.description: Whether users do not have calendars available

basic_user_search.description: Whether colleague search should use basic user directory queries instead of the staff search API

no_maps.description: Whether map views are disabled in the application

allow_dark_mode.description: Whether users are allowed to switch the application to the dark theme

auto_release.description: Settings for prompting users who are not in the office to release their upcoming resource bookings. Per resource type overrides can be set using `<type>_time_before` and `<type>_time_after` keys

time_before.description: Minutes before the booking start time to begin prompting the user. Capped at 60

time_after.description: Minutes after the booking start time that the booking is released if not kept

resources.description: Booking types that auto release applies to e.g. `desk`, `parking`

all_day_start.description: Hour of the day used as the start time for all day bookings when checking for release

colleagues_require_auth.description: Whether colleague search requires querying the user directory as an authenticated user. When `false`, the staff search API is used instead

global_search.description: Whether the global search bar is shown in the top bar. Defaults to enabled

group_events_calendar.description: ID (email) of the calendar used to list group events

idle_timeout.description: Minutes of user inactivity on the meeting form before prompting to discard changes. Defaults to 5

use_region.description: Whether locker listings should be scoped to the active region instead of the active building

week_start.description: First day of the week for schedule and calendar views. `0` is Sunday through `6` for Saturday

hide_contacts.description: Whether to hide the contacts section

chat.description: Settings for the global chat widget

enabled.description: Whether the global chat widget is shown in the app

use_websocket.description: Legacy. Source schedule events from a websocket binding instead of the API. Superseded by `event_sources`

use_driver.description: Legacy. Source schedule events from the bookings driver. Superseded by `event_sources`

event_sources.description: List of sources to load schedule events from. Overrides the legacy `use_driver` and `use_websocket` settings

legend.description: Legend entries mapping booking statuses to colours on the schedule view

name.description: Display name for the legend entry

color.description: CSS colour for the legend entry

space_display.description: Settings for configuring the display of spaces on the UI

show_images.description: Whether UI should render images associated with the space

users.description: Settings for the user directory listing

show_avatars.description: Whether to show user avatars in the directory user list

min_search_length.description: Minimum number of characters required before performing a directory search. Defaults to 3

lockers.description: Data associated with the locker booking flow

allow_all_day.description: Whether the all day option is available for locker bookings. Overrides app.bookings.allow_all_day

allow_time_changes.description: Whether users can change the time of locker bookings. Defaults to enabled

disabled_date_select.description: Whether date selection is disabled on the locker form

disabled_start_time.description: Whether start time selection is disabled on the locker form

hide_end_time.description: Whether to hide the end time field on the locker form

max_duration.description: Maximum locker booking duration in minutes. Overrides app.bookings.max_duration. Defaults to 480

show_calendar_links.description: Whether add to calendar links are shown on the locker booking success view

use_building_timezone.description: Whether locker booking times should use the building's timezone. Overrides app.bookings.use_building_timezone

bookable_hours.description: Bookable time window as hours of the day (0-24). For example, `8` is 8:00 AM and `19` is 7:00 PM.

start.description: Earliest allowed booking start time as hour of the day (0-24).

end.description: Latest allowed booking end time as hour of the day (0-24).

route.description: Path that the link routes to internally

query_params.description: Query parameters to add to the route

background.description: URL of the background image to associate with the link

id.description: Unique URL-safe identifier for the menu item.

name.description: Display name for the menu item.

url.description: Third-party URL to embed in an iframe.

external.description: Open the URL as an external link instead of embedding it in the app.

icon.description: Material Symbols icon name to show in the top menu. Defaults to `open_in_browser`.

type.description: Type of icon to render. Either `img` or `icon`

src.description: URL of the image icon to display

class.description: CSS class to apply to icon container element

content.description: Content to add to the icon container element

id.description: Unique value identifying this request type

value.description: Unique value identifying this request type

name.description: Display label for the request type. Supports translation keys.

label.description: Display label for the request type. Supports translation keys.

description.description: Description text shown below the label. Supports translation keys.

badge.description: Optional badge text shown alongside the request type. Supports translation keys.

groups.description: Optional list of user groups that can see this request type. If empty or omitted, the type is visible to all users.

book_as.description: Optional host selection mode for this request type. When omitted or invalid, the host field is hidden.

forced_time.description: Optional fixed start and end time for this request type. When set, the shift picker is hidden and the form time is locked to this range.

start_time.description: Start time in minutes from midnight

end_time.description: End time in minutes from midnight

id.description: Unique identifier for the shift preset. `custom` is reserved and added automatically.

name.description: Display string for the shift preset

start_time.description: Shift start time in minutes from midnight

end_time.description: Shift end time in minutes from midnight

groups.description: Optional list of user groups that can see this shift preset. If empty or omitted, the preset is visible to all users.
